title: Retain session and underlying read failure in prospective root refresh host diagnostics
outcome: A failed prospective root read can be diagnosed from the host console by session and underlying failure, while agent notices and retained report scope stay safely redacted.
acceptance: A prospective focus/root refresh refusal logs its session id and the underlying read or parse failure to the host console, distinguishing at least unavailable transport from a canonical refusal; the static agent notice and original retained closing scope are unchanged and carry no source payload or raw canonical claim/work identifiers.
